data.summary: Scene2DModule owns CameraRegistry2D, LightRegistry2D, and Entity::Domain instances that duplicate ownership from CameraModule and EntityModule, creating parallel worlds where scene-loaded objects are invisible to the modules that should drive them.
strengths: SceneLoader2D + SceneLoadContext pattern is clean and reference-based
ModuleRef pattern already established by consumers
CameraModule already demonstrates correct ownership/update pattern
Clear loader vs validator separation between Scene2DModule and Scene2DTestStageModule
debt: D1: Scene2DModule owns mCameraRegistry — scene cameras isolated from CameraModule's actively-updated registry
D2: Scene2DModule owns mEntityDomain — scene entities not ticked by EntityModule::DoUpdate
D3: Scene2DModule owns mLightRegistry with no per-frame driver
D4: CameraModule name mismatches Dia::Camera2D:: engine namespace
D5: Scene2DModule calls EndOfFrame() on a domain it shouldn't own
duplication: SceneLoadContext constructed identically in DoStart and DoStop
hidden_coupling: Scene2DTestStageModule uses mutable GetEntityDomain() bypassing EntityModule
VisualDebuggerModule and PickingModule hold ModuleRef<CameraModule> — must update on rename
.diaapp manifests reference CameraModule by type_id string
Scene2DTestStageModule lacks dependency on EntityModule/CameraModule because Scene2DModule owns everything
missing_tests: No test verifying scene entities appear in EntityModule's domain
No test verifying scene cameras accessible via CameraModule's registry
likely_invariants: I1: After scene load, camera registry contains all .diascene cameras
I2: After scene load, light registry contains all .diascene lights
I3: After scene load, entity domain has all .diascene entities spawned
I4: SceneLoader2D::Unload removes exactly what it loaded
I5: CameraModule's default camera always registered and active
I6: EntityModule hierarchy pools registered before scene creates entities
I8: PickingModule and VisualDebuggerModule access camera via same runtime module
recommended_cleanup_order: 2. Create Light2DModule (owns LightRegistry2D, follows CameraModule pattern)
3. Rewire Scene2DModule (remove owned registries/domain, add ModuleRefs, build SceneLoadContext from siblings)
4. Update Scene2DTestStage .diaapp (add EntityModule, Camera2DModule, Light2DModule; update dependencies)
5. Update Scene2DTestStageModule (access domain via EntityModule, cameras via Camera2DModule, lights via Light2DModule)
